kaimaruFrontage.gameAccess: The south entrance of Oreum-gil and the west lift gate are open for exploration only. The real-world map marks both as vehicle-restricted. Only the connecting frontage and its exit are open.

architecture.reconstruction: Entrance and glazing, brick piers, stair approach, N11 marker, planted verge, cycle row and bus waiting area use the May 2023 street scene. The KAIST white paper shows the entrance at its April 2025 reopening. Sizes, small planting and the arrangement of parked bicycles are estimates.

title: KAIST Kart 3 · Campus Drive
campus: KAIST Daejeon main campus and nearby roads

geography.method: Projected the outdoor map into local metres. Road vertices retain shared OSM IDs. Road widths and building heights are estimates where OSM has no measurements. Plazas, parking and mapped courtyards retain their outlines. Topology follows the source and no link is inferred from overlapping lines at different heights.
geography.imagery: The 3D campus is reconstructed from geographic data and available visual references. This dataset does not establish NAVER panorama coverage.
geography.carAccess: Driving follows connected outdoor motor streets, service roads and surface parking. Visitor/customer and destination-only roads admit cars approaching the facility. Walks, trails, steps, cycleways, sidewalks, lawns and pedestrian plazas are scenery. Private, permit-only, emergency-only and conditional vehicle access are excluded. Mapped physical blockers and actual gates retain their restrictions. In Campus Drive the 72 m photographed Kaimaru frontage from Oreum-gil to the west gate is open as a game exception. OSM marks both real-world gates motor_vehicle=no.

terrain.attribution: Ho, Y.-F., Grohmann, C. H., Lindsay, J., Reuter, H. I., Parente, L., Witjes, M., and Hengl, T. (2025). Global ensemble digital terrain modeling and parametrization at 30 m resolution (GEDTM30): a data fusion approach based on ICESat-2, GEDI and multisource data. PeerJ 13:e19673. OpenGeoHub / OpenTopography.
terrain.changes: Cropped to the Daejeon campus and surrounding hills. Interpolated in local metres. Known road profiles use the supplied grade observations. Pavement and bridge elevations between observations are reconstructed.
terrain.limitations: Approximate 30 m machine-learning bare-earth model, not a pavement survey. Source Float32 values treated as metres after independent cross-check; an inconsistent GDAL scale tag is retained in the offline audit.

officialCampusDirectory.scope: Campus locations and public building directory.

canopy.source: Meta and World Resources Institute, High Resolution Canopy Height Maps v2 (2026), source imagery © 2016 Vantor. Accessed 21 November 2026.
canopy.changes: Local maxima in the smoothed canopy-height raster after reprojection, minimum crown separation and filtering. Positions are crown estimates, not surveyed trunks.

architecture.changes: Original geometry based on public street views, supplied photographs, mapped footprints and campus or architect publications. The review includes building masses, visible interiors, pedestrian approaches, parking, road markings, bridge structures and planting.
architecture.limitations: Dimensions are visual estimates wherever published plans or building heights were unavailable. Some parking rows are traced from overhead views. Vehicle occupancy, building interiors and supplementary vegetation are interpretive. The latest public imagery differs in age and season across campus.

streetViews.notes: The November 2026 map review used the latest available panorama at each surveyed location. Capture month varies by street. Independently registered stations carry a capture month in the atlas. Older approximate reference links remain available. The game opens original imagery on the provider site. Vehicle access follows mapped motor roads, observed driveways and entry controls.
